step_by_step_reasoning: I need to find the number of reviews that mention 'not useful' in our store. Currently, I'm on the 'All Reviews' page for the product 'Broad St. Flapover Briefcase', showing 8 reviews. The accessibility tree lists 5 review rows with truncated review text. To count reviews containing 'not useful', I should first set the 'View per page' combobox to 200 to display all 8 records at once, avoiding pagination issues. Then, I need to filter the reviews for 'not useful' using the textbox in the 'Review' column of the filter row. After applying the filter, I can count the number of review rows displayed (excluding header and filter rows) and return that count as the result. This approach is efficient and avoids navigating to individual review pages. I must use Accessibility Tree-centric selectors: locate the combobox in the cell with 'View 20 per page', change it to 200, then find the textbox in the filter row under the 'Review' column, type 'not useful', click the 'Search' button, and count the rows. No functions from the knowledge base are provided, so I'll use Playwright directly. I'll ensure not to change language settings and handle the page state correctly.

async def act(page):
    import asyncio
    # Set the 'View per page' combobox to 200 to show all records
    view_per_page_cell = page.get_by_role('cell').filter(has=page.get_by_text('View 20 per page'))
    view_per_page_combobox = view_per_page_cell.get_by_role('combobox')
    await view_per_page_combobox.select_option('200')
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
    await asyncio.sleep(2)  # Allow time for page update

    # Filter reviews for 'not useful' using the textbox in the 'Review' column of the filter row
    # Locate the filter row (the row with 'Any' in the first cell)
    filter_row = page.get_by_role('row').filter(has=page.get_by_role('cell', name='Any'))
    # Within the filter row, find the textbox under the 'Review' column
    # The 'Review' column is the sixth column (after ID, Created On, Status, Title, Nickname)
    # Use .nth(5) to get the sixth cell (0-indexed) and then get the textbox within it
    review_filter_cell = filter_row.get_by_role('cell').nth(5)  # Index 5 corresponds to the 'Review' column
    review_textbox = review_filter_cell.get_by_role('textbox')
    await review_textbox.fill('not useful')
    # Click the 'Search' button to apply the filter
    search_button = page.get_by_role('button', name='Search')
    await search_button.click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
    await asyncio.sleep(2)  # Allow time for filter to apply

    # Count the number of review rows displayed, excluding header and filter rows
    header_row = page.get_by_role('row', name='ID Created On Status Title Nickname Review Visible In Type Product Name Product SKU Action')
    filter_row = page.get_by_role('row').filter(has=page.get_by_role('cell', name='Any'))
    review_rows = page.get_by_role('row').filter(has_not=header_row).filter(has_not=filter_row)
    count = await review_rows.count()
    return count
